title: QUIC Interop Runner HTTP/3 Endpoint Adapter Verification
verification_method: Build, focused unit tests, HTTP/3 loopback tests, HTTP/3 qlog diagnostics tests, requirement-home trace tests, local runner dry-run planning, and SpecTrace validation.
preconditions: The HTTP/3 and QPACK module projects are present in the solution.
The interop harness Dockerfile and entrypoint remain the runner-facing endpoint image.
The local quic-interop-runner checkout is available when running the dry-run or live runner command.
scope: Verify that the repository exposes a bounded `TESTCASE=http3` interop-runner endpoint path for both client and server roles, emits optional HTTP/3 qlog diagnostics for interop debugging, and does not weaken unsupported-testcase behavior or non-HTTP/3 dispatch paths.
procedure: Review `SPEC-QUIC-INT.json` and confirm `REQ-QUIC-INT-0030` links to this verification artifact.

Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/interop/Invoke-QuicInteropRunner.ps1 -DryRun -RunnerRoot C:\src\quic-interop\quic-interop-runner -LocalRole both -ImplementationSlot quic-go -PeerImplementationSlots quic-go -TestCases http3 -RunnerTimeoutSeconds 240 -ArtifactsRoot .artifacts\interop-runner\http3-local`.
expected_result: The build is clean, focused tests pass, the dry-run maps `http3` to a supported/executed local runner cell using the interop harness image, and SpecTrace validation accepts the new requirement, architecture, work-item, and verification artifacts.
evidence: 2026-05-25: `dotnet build Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors after adding HTTP/3 qlog diagnostics.
status_summary: Passed for the bounded adapter, packaging, documentation, and local dry-run planning surfaces. Live local quic-go/quic-go `http3` runner attempts currently build and launch the endpoint image, negotiate HTTP/3, and read the first server-side request, but still stall before client download completion; those failed attempts are preserved under `.artifacts/interop-runner/http3-local-live`. A later runtime slice must close that live runner stall before the cell is promoted as green interop evidence.
